title: Horizon Scans can be accelerated using novel information retrieval and artificial intelligence tools
abstract: arXiv:2504.01627v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Introduction: Horizon scanning in healthcare assesses early signals of innovation, crucial for timely adoption. Current horizon scanning faces challenges in efficient information retrieval and analysis, especially in grey literature, presenting a need for innovative tools.   Methodology: This article introduces SCANAR and AIDOC, open-source Python-based tools designed to improve horizon scanning. SCANAR automates the retrieval and processing of news articles, using de-duplication and unsupervised relevancy ranking. AIDOC aids filtration by leveraging large language models and text embeddings for calculation of semantic similarity, to reorder data based on relevancy.   Results: Twelve internal datasets from horizon scans and four external benchmarking datasets were used. SCANAR improved retrieval efficiency by automating processes previously dependent on manual labour. AIDOC displayed work-saving potential, achieving around 65%

translated_title: 地平线扫描可以通过新颖的信息检索和人工智能工具来加速
translated_abstract: 引言：医疗保健领域的地平线扫描用于评估创新的早期信号，这对于及时采用新技术至关重要。当前的地平线扫描在高效信息检索和分析方面面临挑战，尤其是在灰色文献领域，因此需要创新工具。方法：本文介绍了SCANAR和AIDOC，这是两个旨在改进地平线扫描的开源Python工具。SCANAR自动化新闻文章的检索和处理流程，采用去重和无监督相关性排序技术。AIDOC通过利用大语言模型和文本嵌入来计算语义相似度以辅助筛选，根据相关性对数据进行重新排序。结果：研究使用了十二个来自地平线扫描的内部数据集和四个外部基准测试数据集。SCANAR通过自动化以往依赖人工的流程提高了检索效率。AIDOC展示了节省工作量的潜力，实现了约65%……
tldr: 本文开发了两个开源Python工具SCANAR和AIDOC，前者自动化新闻检索与处理流程，后者利用大语言模型和文本嵌入计算语义相似度进行智能筛选排序，从而显著加速了医疗保健领域的地平线扫描工作。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SCANAR and AIDOC, two open-source Python tools that accelerate healthcare horizon scanning by automating news retrieval and processing, and by leveraging large language models and text embeddings for semantic similarity-based filtration and reordering.
